remarks: Coastal Living at Seaside Villas in Dana Point!    Enjoy the ocean breeze at Breezewood, just a short walk from the beach with private-gate access to nearby walking and biking trails. This townhouse-style condo offers resort-style amenities, including a clubhouse, two pools (one heated year-round), and two jacuzzis. The spacious interior features an upgraded gas fireplace, formal dining area, breakfast bar, kitchen nook, and downstairs laundry. Upstairs, generously sized bedrooms, remodeled bathrooms and closets, plantation shutters, and upgraded windows add comfort and style. The extra-large primary suite offers two closets and a double-sink vanity. Relax in the travertine front courtyard
